meaning:
δι-ηγέομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;]
to set out in detail, recount, describe: absol., Heb.11:32; with accusative of thing(s), Act.8:33; with dative of person(s), before πῶς, Mrk.5:16, Act.9:27 12:17; ἅ εἶδον, Mrk.9:9; ὅσα ἐποίησε, -αν, Luk.8:39 9:10.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.
“Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had…
In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”
What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets,
